cases.sentence: Если бы Господь был не на нашей ___, да скажет Израиль.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Когда напали на нас ___, то они поглотили бы нас живьем.
cases.explain: Люди is the grammatical subject of напали (attacked), so it stands in the nominative case.
Гнев is the subject of the verb разгорелся (was kindled), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Тогда потопили бы нас ___, поток пронесся бы над нами.
cases.explain: Воды is the grammatical subject of потопили бы (would have overwhelmed), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Поток пронесся бы над ___, бурные воды прошли бы над душой нашей.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Благословен Господь, который не отдал нас добыче в их ___.
cases.explain: The preposition в with accusative indicates motion into or placement within; зубы is the object being targeted.

cases.sentence: Наша душа избавилась, как ___ из сети ловца.
cases.explain: Птица is the subject of the implied comparison, standing in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Помощь наша в имени ___, сотворившего небо и землю.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with genitive expresses the notion of location within a thing's sphere; the possessive genitive follows.

reading.ru: Если бы Господь был не на нашей стороне, да скажет Израиль.
reading.question: What would not have happened if the Lord had not been on Israel's side?
options: They would not have been swallowed alive
They would have built the Temple
They would have lived in peace
reading.correct: They would not have been swallowed alive
reading.explain: The text says if the Lord had not been on their side, 'they would have swallowed us alive.'

reading.ru: Тогда потопили бы нас воды, поток пронесся бы над нами.
reading.question: What metaphor is used to describe the threat they would have faced?
options: Overwhelming waters and a rushing stream
reading.correct: Overwhelming waters and a rushing stream
reading.explain: The text describes the danger using the metaphor of waters and a stream overwhelming them.

reading.ru: Благословен Господь, который не отдал нас добыче в их зубы.
reading.question: What does the Psalmist say God did not do?
options: Give them as prey to their enemies' teeth
reading.correct: Give them as prey to their enemies' teeth
reading.explain: The blessing is specifically that God 'did not give us as prey to their teeth.'

reading.ru: Наша душа избавилась, как птица из сети ловца.
reading.question: To what is the soul's deliverance compared?
options: A bird escaping from a snare
reading.correct: A bird escaping from a snare
reading.explain: The text uses the simile 'как птица из сети ловца' — like a bird from the snare of a fowler.

reading.question: What is the result of the broken net?
reading.explain: After stating the net is broken, the text immediately says 'we have been delivered/escaped.'

reading.ru: Помощь наша в имени Господа, сотворившего небо и землю.
reading.question: Where is the Psalmist's help found?
options: In the name of the Lord who made heaven and earth
In the counsel of the wise
reading.correct: In the name of the Lord who made heaven and earth
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.'
